definitions.explanation: Speaking aloud to oneself without addressing anyone, often while thinking or working.

examples.english: He talks to himself a lot.
"This is a problem," I muttered to myself.

examples.japanese: {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{聞|き}かれていた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I thought I was talking to myself, but someone heard me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぶつぶつ→ぶつぶつ：05364_butsubutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っていて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{気|き}に→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The person sitting next to me was mumbling to themselves, and it bothered me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦つい→つい：02564_tsui⟧{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧しまう。
examples.english: When I'm thinking about a difficult problem, I end up talking to myself without realizing it.

notes:
{独|ひと}り{言|ごと} is speaking aloud to oneself — muttering, thinking out loud, the words that escape while you work through a problem. It names the utterance, not the habit, so it is counted and 'said': {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧.

Formation: {独|ひと}り 'alone' + {言|ごと} 'saying, words.'

Orthography:
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}: the standard writing
- ひとりごと: very common in hiragana
- {独言|ひとりごと}: a compact kanji form, uncommon

Collocations:
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to talk to oneself
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to talk to oneself a lot
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ように→よう：01114_you⟧: as if talking to oneself — often used of something said in earshot but not addressed to anyone
- ⟦ぶつぶつ→ぶつぶつ：05364_butsubutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}: mumbling to oneself

Other 〜{言|ごと} words, all naming a kind of speech:
- ⟦{寝言|ねごと}→寝言：07393_negoto⟧: sleep-talking
- ⟦{泣|な}き{言|ごと}→泣き言：15899_nakigoto⟧: whining, complaining
- ⟦たわ{言|ごと}→たわ言：07394_tawagoto⟧: nonsense, drivel
